The RoW issues existed in Kollam and Trivandrum, Kerala, where the Petitioner was directed by the Hon’ble High Court and the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India to pay compensation for trees, crops, and land value diminution. Based on the judgments of these courts, the District Courts awarded or increased the initial compensation for trees and crops using the multiplier method. In cases of land value diminution, landowners received up to 100% of the land value where towers had been erected. The Petitioner either complied with or challenged these compensation awards before the Hon’ble High Court through Civil Revision Petitions (CRPs). Among several CRPs filed against the District Court’s enhancement orders, 86 remain pending before the Hon’ble High Court of Kerala. To prevent the execution of these orders or attachment of the Petitioner's movable assets and bank accounts, the Petitioner has been depositing the required payments with the District Court.
